drills.name: Passing Gates
drills.description: Pairs pass through a two-cone gate five yards apart, one touch to receive, one to pass. After ten clean passes, move to a new gate at a longer distance.
drills.coachingPoints: Inside of the foot, lock the ankle, pass to your partner's back foot.

drills.name: Rondo 4v1
drills.description: Four players keep the ball from one defender inside an 8x8 grid. The defender who wins the ball swaps in for the passer who lost it.
drills.coachingPoints: Open your body before the ball arrives so you already know your next pass.

drills.name: First Touch Box
drills.description: Partner drives balls in on the ground and in the air. Receiver takes a directional first touch out of a two-yard cone box and passes back. Ten reps, then switch.
drills.coachingPoints: Cushion the ball and push your first touch out of your feet, not underneath you.

drills.name: Switch the Field
drills.description: Two cone grids 30 yards apart. Each team connects three short passes in its grid, then drives a long ball to the far grid and the passer follows their pass.
drills.coachingPoints: Strike through the bottom half of the ball and get your head up before you switch.

drills.name: Finishing Circuit
drills.description: Three lines outside the box: lay-off and shoot, dribble and shoot, run onto a cross and finish. Shoot, retrieve your ball, rotate to the next line.
drills.coachingPoints: Pick your corner before the ball arrives, then hit it low and hard.

drills.name: Turn and Shoot
drills.description: Player checks to the top of the box with back to goal, receives from the line, turns over either shoulder, and shoots within two touches.
drills.coachingPoints: Check your shoulder before the pass comes so the turn is already decided.

drills.name: Volley Toss Finish
drills.description: Partner underhand-tosses from ten yards; shooter finishes first-time with laces or a side volley into the goal. Five reps each side, then switch roles.
drills.coachingPoints: Toe down, knee over the ball, short punch of a swing.

drills.name: 1v1 to Goal
drills.description: Attacker starts at midfield cone, defender closes from the goal line; attacker tries to beat the defender and finish past the keeper. Loser of the duel plays defense next rep.
drills.coachingPoints: Attack the defender's front foot at speed and shoot before they can recover.

drills.name: Dribble Maze
drills.description: Cones scattered across a 20x20 grid; every player dribbles freely, avoiding cones and other players. On the whistle, change speed or direction on command.
drills.coachingPoints: Small touches, eyes up between every touch.

drills.name: Move of the Day
drills.description: Teach one move (scissors, Cruyff, or stepover) at a cone. Players dribble in, execute the move at the cone, and accelerate away. Repeat with both feet.
drills.coachingPoints: Sell the fake with your whole body, then explode out of the move.

drills.name: Sprint Dribble Relay
drills.description: Teams line up behind a cone; first player speed-dribbles 25 yards around a far cone and back, then tags the next dribbler. First team to finish wins.
drills.coachingPoints: Push the ball ahead with your laces and run onto it. Don't tap and wait.

drills.name: Shield and Steal
drills.description: One ball per pair inside a small circle. Possessor shields for 30 seconds while the partner tries to poke it away, then switch roles.
drills.coachingPoints: Ball on your far foot, arm bar for balance, keep your body between defender and ball.

drills.name: Defend the Gate
drills.description: Attacker tries to dribble through a five-yard cone gate; defender jockeys and tackles when the ball is exposed. Three reps, then swap roles.
drills.coachingPoints: Low and sideways-on, patient feet. Tackle only when the touch is heavy.

drills.name: Press the Back Pass
drills.description: 5v5 possession in a grid. Any backward pass is the trigger: the two nearest defenders sprint to press the receiver while the rest cut passing lanes.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint the first five yards, then slow down and curve your run to cut off one side.

drills.name: Keeper Handling Warmup
drills.description: Partner serves rolled balls, waist-high balls, and chest-high balls from ten yards. Keeper works scoop, basket catch, and W-catch, ten of each.
drills.coachingPoints: Get your body behind the ball first. Hands are the backup, not the plan.

drills.name: Keeper Arc and Set
drills.description: Keeper shuffles along a cone arc between the posts, sets on the server's touch, and saves a shot placed to either side. Six shots, rotate keepers.
drills.coachingPoints: Feet set before the shot. You can't dive while you're still moving.

drills.name: Shadow Back Four
drills.description: A line of four defenders slides, drops, and steps together as the coach walks a ball across the field. No opponents. Pure shape and spacing.
drills.coachingPoints: Move the moment the ball moves; stay connected to the player beside you.

drills.name: 3v3 to Small Goals
drills.description: Two simultaneous 3v3 games on 25x20 fields with small cone goals, no keepers. Three-minute games, losers rotate off if numbers allow.
drills.coachingPoints: First look forward. Score fast before the defense is set.

drills.name: Transition 3v2 Waves
drills.description: Three attackers go against two defenders toward goal. The instant the ball is lost or scored, the defenders outlet to a new ball and attack the other way with a teammate joining.
drills.coachingPoints: Attack immediately after winning it. The first five seconds are the advantage.

drills.name: Give-and-Go Gauntlet
drills.description: Dribbler plays a wall pass with a stationary partner at each of three cones down the field, sprinting onto each return, and finishes with a shot. Switch roles each run.
drills.coachingPoints: Pass and immediately sprint into the space behind. The pass is the start of your run.

drills.name: One-Touch Wall Passing
drills.description: Player passes against a wall or rebound board from eight yards using one touch only, alternating feet every five passes. Three sets of thirty.
drills.coachingPoints: Lock the ankle and pass with the inside of the foot. Open your hips to the target before it arrives.

drills.name: Y Passing Pattern
drills.description: Three players form a Y and run a set pattern of pass, return, and third-man pass, then rotate positions. Six cycles each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Pass to the back foot so he can turn. Move as soon as it leaves your foot.

drills.name: Weighted Pass Ladder
drills.description: Partners pass across increasing distances of ten, twenty, and thirty yards, with the ball required to stop within one step of the receiver. Ten passes at each distance.
drills.coachingPoints: Weight it so he doesn't have to move. Firm and flat beats soft and bouncing.

drills.name: First Touch Out of Feet
drills.description: Server tosses or passes to a partner who must take a first touch into space away from a cone defender, then pass back. Twenty reps alternating which side he opens to.
drills.coachingPoints: Your first touch is your first pass. Take it away from pressure, not into it.

drills.name: Receive and Turn Gates
drills.description: Player checks to a server, receives with the back foot, and turns to play through one of two gates behind him. Twelve reps, alternating which shoulder he opens over.
drills.coachingPoints: Look over your shoulder before it comes. Half turn as you receive, don't receive and then turn.

drills.name: Aerial Control Cushion
drills.description: Server lofts a ball to a partner who cushions it with the thigh or the inside of the foot and settles it inside a five yard square. Fifteen reps each surface.
drills.coachingPoints: Give with the surface as it arrives. Kill it dead inside the square or the rep doesn't count.

drills.name: Driven Ball Technique
drills.description: Players strike thirty to forty yard driven passes to a partner, keeping the ball below head height. Twelve strikes each foot.
drills.coachingPoints: Laces through the middle of the ball, plant foot beside it. Low and fast beats high and slow.

drills.name: Switch Through the Middle Zone
drills.description: Grid split into three zones. The ball must cross the middle zone in one pass to a player on the far side who is already moving. Eight switches each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Switch it before the pressure arrives, not after. Play it into his run, not his feet.

drills.name: Rondo 5v2
drills.description: Five players around a fifteen yard square with two defenders in the middle. Two-touch maximum, and the defender who wins it swaps with the player who lost it.
drills.coachingPoints: Move before you receive, not after. Split the two of them whenever the gap opens.

drills.name: Two-Touch Pressure Square
drills.description: Four attackers keep the ball inside a twenty yard square against two pressing defenders with a two-touch limit. Ninety second rounds, defenders rotate each round.
drills.coachingPoints: First touch sets the pass. Head up before it arrives or you have already lost it.

drills.name: Play Out of the Back
drills.description: Back four plus a goalkeeper build out from a goal kick against three forwards pressing. Ten reps, and the pressing team scores a point for any turnover in the defensive third.
drills.coachingPoints: Split wide and give him angles. If it isn't on, go back to the keeper and start again.

drills.name: Laces Strike Repetitions
drills.description: Player strikes a stationary ball at a target from eighteen yards, focusing on plant foot placement and a locked ankle. Ten strikes each foot.
drills.coachingPoints: Plant foot beside the ball pointing at goal. Head down, hit through the middle, follow through toward the target.

drills.name: Side Foot Placement Finishes
drills.description: Player receives a square pass twelve yards from goal and side foots it into a corner rather than blasting it. Twelve finishes, six to each corner.
drills.coachingPoints: Pass it into the corner, don't shoot it. Placement beats power inside the box.

drills.name: Cutback Finish from the Byline
drills.description: A winger drives to the byline and cuts the ball back to the penalty spot where a runner arrives to finish first time. Eight reps from each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Cut it back behind the defenders, not across the six. Arrive late and hit it first time.

drills.name: Touch, Touch, Shoot
drills.description: Player receives at twenty-five yards, takes two touches forward past a cone, and strikes. Ten reps each foot.
drills.coachingPoints: Big first touch out of your feet, then hit it. Don't take a third touch and let him get set.

drills.name: Cut Inside and Curl
drills.description: Wide player dribbles down the line, cuts inside onto his stronger foot, and curls it toward the far post. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Cut inside sharply, don't drift. Wrap the foot around it and aim for the far corner.

drills.name: Half Volley off the Bounce
drills.description: Server drops a ball from chest height and the striker hits it just as it bounces from fourteen yards. Twelve reps each foot.
drills.coachingPoints: Hit it as it comes up, not at the top of the bounce. Knee over the ball to keep it down.

drills.name: First-Time Finish from the Cross
drills.description: Crosser delivers from the wing and a striker attacks the near post and the far post on alternating reps, finishing first time. Ten reps from each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Attack the ball, don't wait for it. Near post finishes go across, far post finishes go back across.

drills.name: Through Ball to 1v1
drills.description: Striker runs onto a through ball with only the keeper to beat from twenty yards. Eight reps, mixing a clean run and one with a recovering defender.
drills.coachingPoints: Take a touch to the side he is diving from. Wait for him to commit, then pass it past him.

drills.name: Angle Finish One-on-One
drills.description: Striker breaks in from a wide angle against the keeper, so the near post is covered and the finish has to go far post or around him. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: From a tight angle, go far post or take it across him. Never blast it at his near shoulder.

drills.name: Sole and Inside Touch Grid
drills.description: Players dribble inside a fifteen yard grid using only the sole roll and inside-of-the-foot touches, keeping the ball within a stride at all times. Three ninety second rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Small touches, head up. If the ball gets more than a step away, it isn't yours anymore.

drills.name: Tight Grid Traffic Dribble
drills.description: All players dribble inside a shrinking grid while keeping their heads up to avoid collisions. The coach removes cones every forty-five seconds to tighten the space.
drills.coachingPoints: See the player, not just the ball. Change direction before you run out of room.

drills.name: Move of the Week Progression
drills.description: One move, such as the step-over, scissors, or Cruyff turn, taught in three stages: alone with no defender, against a passive defender, then live one-on-one. Four minutes at each stage.
drills.coachingPoints: Sell it with your shoulders and your eyes. Explode out of the move, the move itself beats nobody.

drills.name: Two Gates 1v1
drills.description: Attacker faces a defender with two gates behind him and must dribble through either one. Defender only has to protect one at a time, so the attacker reads which. Four reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Attack the gap he isn't covering. Change speed once you commit.

drills.name: Push and Sprint to Goal
drills.description: Player takes one big touch into open space and sprints thirty yards with the ball at speed before finishing. Six reps with full recovery.
drills.coachingPoints: Push it into the space in front, then run. Touch every third stride, not every stride.

drills.name: Shield and Turn Out
drills.description: Player receives with his back to a defender, shields for three seconds using his body, then turns out to the open side. Six reps each, then switch roles.
drills.coachingPoints: Arm across, body between him and the ball, knees bent. Feel where he is, then turn the other way.

drills.name: Jockey and Delay
drills.description: Defender faces an attacker in a ten yard channel with the only job of delaying him for eight seconds, not winning the ball. Four reps each, then switch.
drills.coachingPoints: Side on, low, and patient. Show him to your strong side and wait for his heavy touch.

drills.name: Force Him Wide
drills.description: Defender protects a central gate while an attacker starts thirty yards out. The defender must angle his approach to push the attacker toward the sideline. Six reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Approach on a curve, not a straight line. Your body shape decides where he goes.

drills.name: Press the Trigger Pass
drills.description: Two defenders stay passive until a deliberately slow or backward pass is played, then press together. Ten reps with the coach calling out whether the trigger was read correctly.
drills.coachingPoints: Press on the bad touch or the backward pass, not on every pass. Go together or don't go.

drills.name: Cover Shadow Pressing
drills.description: Defender presses the ball while using his body position to block the passing lane behind him. Eight reps with a coach checking whether the lane stayed closed.
drills.coachingPoints: Press with the pass behind you already cut off. Curve your run so your shadow covers him.

drills.name: Front Foot Block Tackle
drills.description: Two players approach a ball placed between them and work a firm, square block tackle through the middle of the ball. Twelve reps at controlled speed.
drills.coachingPoints: Ankle locked, inside of the foot, body weight through it. Timid tackles are how people get hurt.

drills.name: Recovery Tackle from Behind
drills.description: Defender starts two yards behind an attacker and has to recover alongside and poke the ball away with the near foot, never from behind. Six reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Get alongside first, then take it. Never reach through the back of him.

drills.name: Back Four Slide and Squeeze
drills.description: Four defenders move as a unit while a coach passes the ball across the top of the formation, sliding across and squeezing up together. Three minutes continuous.
drills.coachingPoints: Ball moves, everyone moves. Stay within ten yards of each other the whole time.

drills.name: Compact Between the Lines
drills.description: Defenders and midfielders work together to deny a player receiving between the lines while the ball is circulated in front of them. Ten possessions.
drills.coachingPoints: Midfield drops, back line steps up, squeeze the space. Nobody gets to turn in the middle.

drills.name: Keeper W Catch Reps
drills.description: Server throws and strikes balls at chest and head height from twelve yards. Keeper catches every one with thumbs and index fingers forming a W behind the ball. Twenty-five reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Hands behind the ball, thumbs close, elbows soft. Bring it into your chest every time.

drills.name: Low Ball Scoop and Collapse
drills.description: Keeper handles rolling balls with a scoop, then balls rolled just wide that require a collapse dive onto the side. Fifteen of each.
drills.coachingPoints: Get your body behind the rolling ball, never just the hands. On the collapse, top hand over, bottom hand behind.

drills.name: High Ball Claim
drills.description: Server lofts balls into the six yard box and the keeper attacks them at the highest point with a loud call, taking off from one foot. Fifteen reps, adding a passive attacker after eight.
drills.coachingPoints: Call it loud and early, then go get it. Lead knee up for protection, catch it at full stretch.

drills.name: Set Position on the Shot
drills.description: Keeper shuffles along his line as the coach moves the ball, and must be in a stopped set position every time the coach loads to shoot. Twenty reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Stop and set before he strikes it. Moving when the ball is hit means you go nowhere.

drills.name: Keeper Angle Arc
drills.description: Coach moves the ball around the top of the box and the keeper adjusts along an arc from the goal line, narrowing the angle without straying too far. Twelve positions checked.
drills.coachingPoints: Come off your line on the shooter's angle, not straight out. Set your feet before he looks up.

drills.name: Reaction Save Doubles
drills.description: Keeper faces two shots in quick succession, the first from twelve yards and the second fed immediately after the parry. Twelve pairs of shots.
drills.coachingPoints: Parry wide, never straight back into the middle. Get off the ground before the second shot comes.

drills.name: Screened Shot Reactions
drills.description: Two players stand in front of the keeper as a screen while a coach strikes from eighteen yards. Keeper has to find the ball late through bodies. Fifteen shots.
drills.coachingPoints: Move to see it, don't stand and hope. Stay big and expect a deflection.

drills.name: Keeper Throw and Roll Distribution
drills.description: Keeper distributes to targets at fifteen, twenty-five, and forty yards using a roll, a sidearm throw, and an overarm throw. Eight reps of each.
drills.coachingPoints: Roll it flat so it doesn't bounce. Throw to his front foot so he can play forward.

drills.name: Goal Kick Under Pressure
drills.description: Keeper takes goal kicks with two forwards pressing, choosing between a short pass to a center back, a wide ball to a full back, or a long clearance. Ten reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Look short first, long second. If nothing is on, put it out of play rather than into trouble.

drills.name: Ladder and Cone Quickness
drills.description: Players work four footwork patterns through a cone grid, then finish each trip with a five yard sprint. Two trips per pattern.
drills.coachingPoints: Quick feet, tall posture. The sprint out is the point, not the fancy pattern.

drills.name: T-Drill Change of Direction
drills.description: Four cones in a T shape. Player sprints forward, shuffles left, shuffles right, then backpedals to start. Four reps with full rest.
drills.coachingPoints: Face forward the whole drill. Touch every cone with your hand, no cutting corners.

drills.name: Reaction Start Races
drills.description: Pairs lie or sit facing away from the coach, then sprint fifteen yards on a clap. Six reps alternating starting positions.
drills.coachingPoints: First step goes under your body, not out in front. React, don't anticipate.

drills.name: Twenty-Yard Repeat Sprints
drills.description: Players sprint twenty yards, walk back, and repeat every thirty seconds for eight reps. Times should stay within a step of each other.
drills.coachingPoints: Same time on rep eight as rep one. If you fade, you went out too hard.

drills.name: Interval Tempo Runs
drills.description: Players run the width of the field at about seventy-five percent effort, walk the next width, and repeat for ten widths. Two sets.
drills.coachingPoints: Tempo, not a race. Recover on the walk so you can hold the pace.

drills.name: Bodyweight and Core Stations
drills.description: Four stations at forty-five seconds each: squats, lunges, planks, and glute bridges, with fifteen seconds to rotate. Two rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Control every rep. Knees track over the toes, hips stay level in the plank.

drills.name: Four-Goal Small-Sided Fitness
drills.description: Four-on-four with four small goals so the ball and the players never stop moving. Three-minute rounds with ninety seconds rest, four rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Score in either goal, so change the point of attack fast. Nobody stands still for three minutes.

drills.name: Two-Minute 3v3 Waves
drills.description: Three-on-three to small goals in two-minute bursts with fresh teams rotating in immediately. Six waves per team.
drills.coachingPoints: Full effort for two minutes, then you're off. Sprint back on defense every single time.

drills.name: Six-Pass Possession Game
drills.description: Seven-on-seven in a forty yard grid where six consecutive passes counts as a goal. No shooting, purely retention. Four three-minute rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Support at an angle, never in a straight line behind him. Backward pass is a good pass.

drills.name: Possession with Target Players
drills.description: Six-on-six in a grid with a neutral target player at each end. A point is scored by finding one target and then the other. Four rounds of three minutes.
drills.coachingPoints: Play through the middle to get to the far target. Heads up before you receive.

drills.name: Counter-Attack Waves
drills.description: A defending team wins the ball and immediately attacks the opposite goal against two recovering defenders. Continuous for eight minutes with fresh attackers each wave.
drills.coachingPoints: First pass goes forward, not sideways. Get three players past the ball inside five seconds.

drills.name: Five Seconds to Win It Back
drills.description: Any team that loses the ball has five seconds to win it back before dropping into shape. Play seven-on-seven for four-minute rounds with the coach counting out loud.
drills.coachingPoints: The nearest player presses instantly, everyone else cuts off the escape. Five seconds, then get your shape.

drills.name: Third Man Runs
drills.description: Pattern where the first pass sets up a second pass to a third player arriving into space. Run it as a pattern for five minutes, then live in a small-sided game.
drills.coachingPoints: The pass isn't to the man you look at. Third man times his run as the second pass leaves.

drills.name: Overlap and Underlap Reps
drills.description: A wide player and a fullback combine, with the fullback running outside on one rep and inside on the next. Eight reps of each on both flanks.
drills.coachingPoints: Call which run you're making. Wide player holds the ball until the runner is level.

drills.name: Corner Kick Delivery and Runs
drills.description: Corner taker delivers to two zones, near post and penalty spot, while three attackers run set routes and two defenders mark. Sixteen corners, eight to each zone.
drills.coachingPoints: Same delivery every time so the runs can be timed to it. Start your run late and outside the marker.

drills.name: Free Kick Wall and Routine
drills.description: Defensive unit sets a wall on the keeper's call while the attacking team runs two rehearsed free kick routines from twenty-two yards. Ten kicks from three different angles.
drills.coachingPoints: Keeper sets the wall and the wall does not move. Attackers, decide the routine before you stand over it.

drills.name: Throw-In Options Pattern
drills.description: Thrower works three options on every throw: a checking near player, a runner going behind, and a back option. Twelve throws each side with defenders marking.
drills.coachingPoints: Three options every throw, one of them behind. Throw it and get back on the field immediately.

drills.name: Three Balls in Ten Seconds
drills.description: Three servers feed a striker in sequence from the left, the middle, and the right, so he finishes three balls inside ten seconds. Four rounds each player.
drills.coachingPoints: Reset your feet between each one. Tired finishing is game finishing.

drills.name: Turn and Shoot from the Back
drills.description: Striker receives with his back to goal at eighteen yards, turns on his first touch, and strikes within two more. Eight reps opening each way.
drills.coachingPoints: Check your shoulder before it arrives. Turn on the first touch, not the second.

drills.name: Figure-Eight Close Control
drills.description: Two cones five yards apart. Player dribbles a figure eight around them using inside and outside touches only, for forty-five seconds. Four rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Outside foot around the cone, inside foot back through. Touch on every step when it's tight.

drills.name: Sharks and Minnows
drills.description: Everyone dribbles across a thirty yard grid while two sharks without balls try to kick them out. Anyone who loses his ball becomes a shark. Four rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Head up and change direction early. Shield it with your body when a shark commits.

drills.name: Dribble the Counter 2v1
drills.description: Two attackers break from the halfway line against one recovering defender. The player on the ball carries it at speed and decides whether to take him on or release the runner. Six reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Carry it at him until he commits, then decide. Slowing down lets the second defender arrive.

drills.name: Defend the Two-on-One
drills.description: One defender faces two attackers and has to delay, force the pass, and buy time for a recovering teammate who enters after four seconds. Six reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Don't dive in, you'll lose both of them. Cut the pass and slow the ball down.

drills.name: Keeper Sweeper Reads
drills.description: Keeper starts off his line and reads whether to come out and clear a through ball or drop back into the goal. Ten reps with the coach varying the weight of the pass.
drills.coachingPoints: Decide early and commit fully. Half out is how goals get scored.

drills.name: Box-to-Box Shuttle Runs
drills.description: Players run from one penalty box to the other, jog back, and repeat. Six repetitions with the jog back as the only recovery.
drills.coachingPoints: Run the sprint honestly and the jog honestly. This is the shape of the whole game.
